ai_summary: The S-STEM program provides funding for scholarships and support activities to help low-income students succeed in STEM fields. Eligible applicants include institutions of higher education, with a focus on serving academically talented low-income students enrolled in S-STEM eligible degree programs.
ai_quote: "The main goal of the S-STEM program is to enable academically talented, low-income students to pursue successful careers in promising STEM fields."
